scripts.capture:vscode-smoke: npm run build:native && npm run build && node scripts/capture-vscode-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:native && npm run build && vitest run --no-file-parallelism --testTimeout=45000 tests/native-integration.test.ts tests/stdio-integration.test.ts
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build:native && vitest run tests/discovery-smoke.test.ts
scripts.test:mouse-smoke: npm run build:native && vitest run tests/mouse-smoke.test.ts
scripts.test:keyboard-smoke: npm run build:native && vitest run --testTimeout=30000 tests/keyboard-smoke.test.ts
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:integration
